text:
sam: Quick Q3 hosted capacity question — I'm sketching a "flexpool" plan: small owned baseline + short-term leased backfill for seasonal burst. Need a procurement call by Monday so we can lock discounts.

sam: Proposed baseline buy: 30 A10s (on-prem style racks / dedicated) to cover steady-state inference for low-latency customers. Burst plan: 3-month leases for T4-equivalent capacity that we turn on for peak windows. Rough numbers below.

sam: ```
Week range    Forecast tokens/hr    Required GPU-hrs/day (est)
May 15-Jun 15   1.1M tokens/hr         420
Jun 16-Jul 31   1.8M tokens/hr         700
Aug 1-Sep 30    1.4M tokens/hr         540
Assumptions: avg seq=120, multitenant batching efficiency 1.7x, cache hit 10%
```

anya: FYI APAC burst is correlated with marketing release date (June 22). If that stays, APAC needs ~40% of the peak backfill. Also EU egress costs spiking on rerank jobs — might want local leases.

priya: Quick question: how much do we expect prefix/KV cache improvements to reduce peak GPU hours? If caching saves 15% of tokens during peak, we can trim the leased pool significantly.

sam: Good call — our evals show 12–18% reduction for chat-heavy workloads once prefix cache warms. I'm using 10% in the table to be conservative.

david: Procurement notes: vendor lead times — A10/A30 ~4–6 weeks, A100 ~8–12 weeks for new orders. Leasing vendors can deliver T4-like capacity in 2–3 weeks but pricing scales with term. Committed 3-month lease gets ~12–18% off compared to month-to-month.

david: Cost sketch: buy 30 A10: CAPEX ~$180k (unit ~6k), expected useful life 3 years. Lease 3-month burst (equiv 400 T4s): OPEX ~ $0.36–0.45/hr per unit depending on broker, ~ $250k for the 3-month window (ballpark).

chen: Operational constraints: rack space + PDUs in EU-west are limited Q2 — if we buy baseline there we need to reserve datacenter staging now or choose a nearer region. Networking: cross-region KV cache warmup adds latency initially; for APAC we should prefer local leased nodes.

chen: Proposal draft:
- Buy 30 A10s as baseline (split NA:18, EU:8, APAC:4)
- Lease regionally for burst: 3-month leases timed Jun 15–Sep 15 sized to ~peak shortfall (NA 200 T4-eq, EU 120, APAC 80)
- Keep 10% of burst capacity as spot/short-term on cloud for blue/green testing
- Use quantized fallback model (smaller footprint) as automated regional fallback when latency > 220ms

priya: I support buying the baseline but prefer shifting 2x of the EU baseline to APAC if marketing confirms dates — APAC ramp could be higher. Also, can we negotiate delivery windows with the lease brokers to align with marketing?

sam: Action items before Monday:
- David: finalize vendor quotes + lead times for A10 buy and 3-month lease options (due EOD Fri)
- Chen: check EU rack/PDU availability and backup coloc option (due Fri)
- Priya/Anya: confirm marketing release cadence with Growth and update APAC % for sizing (due Thu)
- Infra-bot: remind team Wed 09:00 about procurement sync

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: procurement-sync / 2050012345 at 2026-06-03 09:00 UTC

sam: If we can get committed lease discounts and a modest CAPEX baseline, this flexpool should keep SLOs during peak without overcommitting. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

anya: +1 to flexpool. One more ask — include a fast-fail rollback plan for leased capacity if latency anomalies appear (automated drain + throttle).

david: I'll include rollback/scale-down SLAs in the broker RFP. Also checking if some vendors will hold inventory with 2-week notice to reduce our exposure.

chen: Noted — I'll draft the failover runbook and canary steps for EU -> NA fallback.

sam: Thanks all. We'll review quotes in the sync.
